properties.c_5_spanda_ananda_integration: Spanda (rhythmic pulsation) and Ananda (harmonic organization) form the dual engines of manifestation
properties.q_0_arises_from_void: Form is the first standing-forth from #0's silence — the 1 the slash cuts from the 0. Its ground is the void it explicates: every determinate owes itself to the indeterminate it leaves behind. Form is the first word, and a first word is only ever spoken into prior silence.
properties.q_0_emerges_from_anuttara: M1's ground is Anuttara — Paramasiva is the first emanation from the void, inheriting the (0/1) non-dual element and the 8-fold zero-zero. Its thrown condition is pure potential (R, Reality) not yet ordered; it stands on the silence and is charged to give it systematic form.
properties.q_1_the_determinate_itself: Form is the material-definitional position as such — the what, the determinate that simply is what it is. In the matheme it is the copula's self-identity, A = A, 'I am the same': to stand forth as this and not that. Not yet related, not yet moving — the bare fact of a content having a shape. Every 'what is X?' is answered in Form's register; Form is the place where the field first consents to be grasped.
properties.q_1_the_logos_grammar: M1 is the structural-logical foundation — the Logos that transforms Anuttara's pure Reality (R) into systematic Order (O) through pre-computational Zero Logic. It is the universal grammar generator: the source of Quaternal Logic itself, unfolding via mod6 through the Ananda harmonic matrices, the Spanda generative engine, and the QL flowering toward quaternionic integration. M1 is where the void acquires a syntax — the blueprint every later subsystem is built upon.
properties.q_2_operates_by_delimitation: Form works by drawing a line — determination is delimitation, the in-quantum (Eckhart's 'insofar as') that bounds a content while holding it open. It stands to Ground as figure to field: to be a figure at all is to cut against what one is not.
properties.q_2_spanda_engine: M1 operates through Spanda — the primordial pulsation, the generative engine that drives the (0/1) into systematic unfolding. It works by rhythmic differentiation: Ananda (harmony) and Spanda (pulse) co-arising, the mod6 framework turning potential into ordered process. The how of Paramasiva is the throb that makes structure live rather than freeze.
properties.q_3_quaternal_logic_architecture: M1's structure is Quaternal Logic itself — the 4+2 architecture, the 16/9 = (4/3)^2 flowering, the mod6 frameworks and quaternionic integration that scaffold all of M2–M5. This is the most formally load-bearing domain: the which by which everything else is structured, the place the kernel says torus-construction actually begins.
properties.q_3_the_unit_before_counting: Form's structure is the unit — the 1 that must exist before 1+1 can be two. Self-identical, the fixed point a system returns to. Repetition has not yet begun; Form is the standing shape that repetition will later count.
properties.q_4_blueprint_for_manifestation: M1 is for blueprint — it exists to bridge unmanifest potential with a coherent plan for cosmic manifestation, providing the frameworks on which Parashakti, Mahamaya, Nara, and Epii are raised. Its why is architectural: so that what Anuttara holds as silence can become a world with a stable grammar.
properties.q_4_for_the_sake_of_graspability: Form is for determinacy — it gives the field something a hand can close on, a name a question can aim at. Without the first 'this', no inquiry has a target; Form is the condition under which anything can be asked after.
properties.q_5_handed_on_as_ground: Form completes by being taken up — it opens into Operation (#2), which moves what Form has fixed, and it sediments back as ground (#0) for the next determination. A form fulfilled is a form handed on: the what becomes the from-which of the next what.
properties.q_5_quaternionic_integration: M1's synthesis is quaternionic integration — the QL flowering culminating where the structural-logical achieves coherent closure and hands its grammar forward to Parashakti's vibration. Paramasiva completes by becoming the syntax the rest of the family speaks: the blueprint sediments into the ground on which manifestation proceeds.
